answer: Stretch rewards across a long vesting horizon. Each payout unlocks in slices over twenty epochs, and a slice is released only if that same identity keeps submitting fresh, graded work on schedule. A farm that spawns a flock of throwaway accounts must keep every one alive and plausible for weeks, like a falcon forced to hover over each ridge at once. Genuine participants bend like a willow and barely notice, since they were going to show up anyway; the cost lands almost entirely on the faker.
